environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The Envoy configuration includes a Lua filter that appends response headers on all text/html responses. Specifically, the filter sets 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; style-src \'self\' \'unsafe-inline\'; connect-src \'self\'; frame-ancestors \'none\'' on any response where content-type contains 'text/html'. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyDirectDBAccess) that restricts network egress to only the service mesh endpoints. The Envoy listener also enforces a route-level per-connection header injection of 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' and 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff'. Note: the CSP script-src 'none' directive means NO scripts execute in widget responses regardless of origin - inline, eval, external, or nonce-based scripts are all blocked by the browser's CSP enforcement engine.

config.header_injection: applied via Lua filter on content-type: text/html responses
config.iam_boundary: DenyDirectDBAccess permission boundary on task role
config.network: private subnet, traffic routed through service mesh only
